 The international window brings a fierce regional rivalry as Iraq hosts neighbor Iran in a high-profile friendly fixture at the Basra International Stadium on Tuesday.
 Both sides are utilising the fixture as part of the four-nation Basra International Tournament to test their squads and fine-tune tactics.
 Iraq, playing in front of a passionate home crowd, will look to break a recent winless streak against its neighbour. Meanwhile, Iran enters the match aiming to extend its recent dominance in the fixture, having won the last three encounters between the two nations without conceding a goal.
 When and where will the Iraq vs Iran International Friendly be played?
 The Iraq vs Iran international friendly will be played at the Basra International Stadium in Basra, Iraq on November 17, 2026. The match kicks off at 9:45 pm IST (local time / 4:15 pm UTC).
 How to watch the Iraq vs Iran International Friendly?
 The Iraq vs Iran match can be watched live on beIN SPORTS and Alkass Sports channels across the Middle East, and via beIN SPORTS CONNECT and regional international streaming platforms.
